questions.question:

Only 1 person sits to the left of E. Only 2 people sit between E and F. C sits immediately to the right of D. G sits immediately to the left of A. Only 1 person sits between F and D.

How many people sit between A and E?
questions.solution:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north.

Only 1 person sits to the left of E.

Only 2 people sit between E and F.

C sits immediately to the right of D.

G sits immediately to the left of A.

Only 1 person sits between F and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1761629a059287748334643503644f29d5b41376202ba902a50842c8f315190f.png] 

People between them are D, C, F and G = 4 people.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

questions.question: In a city, a school is 18 km towards the north of a park. A hospital is 21 km towards the west of the school. A restaurant is 21 km towards the west of the park. How far and in which direction is the restaurant from the hospital?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

Park is at reference point (0, 0)
School is 18 km North of Park → (0, 18)
Hospital is 21 km West of School → (-21, 18)
Restaurant is 21 km West of Park → (-21, 0)

According to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ba7df262dc087ce28d3dd5f8e74b8f919056f993c1ab4807a450bc99f5e9ecb.png] 

So, Restaurant is 18 km directly South of Hospital.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

questions.question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 192 574 563 189 567 (Right)

(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the third digit of the highest number is added to the second digit of the lowest number?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given numbers: 192, 574, 563, 189, 567

Arranging in descending order: 574, 567, 563, 192, 189

Highest number = 574

→ Third digit = 4

Lowest number = 189

→ Second digit = 8

Sum = 4 + 8 = 12

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

questions.question: In a row of 25 people facing north, Ujwala is 5th from the right end. If Siya sits 3rd to the left of Ujwala, then what is Siya’s position from the left end of the row?
questions.solution:
Given:

Ujwala is 5th from the right in a row of 25 people.

Siya sits 3rd to the left of Ujwala.

Ujwala’s position from right = 5

Siya is 3rd to the left of Ujwala → Siya’s position from right = 5 + 3 = 8

Total number of people = 25

Siya’s position from left = 25 − 8 + 1 = 18

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some batteries are torches.

All clocks are torches.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some batteries are clocks.

(II) All torches are clocks.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some batteries are torches.

All clocks are torches.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c2676bff1410dce96414f51b4d9c7f6b13783dfffa1ad3d483d51434c4d85d9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some batteries are clocks → Does not follow (Although some batteries are torches and all clocks are torches, there is no definite information that batteries overlap with clocks.)

II. All torches are clocks → Does not follow (The statement says "All clocks are torches," which means Clocks are a subset of Torches. It does not mean that all Torches are Clocks.)

So, neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
